gizmo.title: Umzobo ovela kwisicatshulwa
gizmo.description: Bhala umzobo njengesicatshulwa (Mermaid): itshati yokuhamba, ulandelelwano, umgca wexesha nokunye. Uzotywa ephepheni nesicatshulwa esingenye indlela.

configure.title: Isihloko
configure.description: Kuboniswa ngaphezulu komzobo kwaye kusetyenziswa njengegama lawo.

configure.title: Umthombo womzobo
configure.description: Isicatshulwa se-Mermaid, umzekelo: flowchart TD, emva koko umgca omnye ngekhonkco ngalinye elifana no-A[Draft] --> B{Ready?}. Yongeza |label| emva kotolo ukulunika ilebhile. Umzobo uyahlaziyeka njengoko uchwetheza.

configure.title: Enye indlela yesicatshulwa
configure.description: Chaza oko kuboniswa ngumzobo kubantu abangakwaziyo ukuwubona. Shiya kungenanto kwitshati yokuhamba ukuze amanyathelo ayo adweliswe wena.

configure.title: Bonisa isicatshulwa esingenye indlela
configure.description: Bonisa isicatshulwa esingenye indlela ngezantsi komzobo. Sihlala sifumaneka kubafundi besikrini.

advanced.title: Ifayile yomthombo
advanced.description: Idilesi yefayile ye-.mmd eza kuzotywa endaweni yesicatshulwa esingentla (https okanye indlela kule sayithi).
